items.question: Which figures are credited with transmitting this amṛta practice?
premises: Dattatreya is named as a sage.
items.inference: Dattatreya and Śukra are presented as transmitters of the practice.
uncertainties: The exact relation to Baladeva in the preceding line is not explicit.
items.plain_english: By Dattatreya, the sage, and by Śukra, the great-souled one.
